title: Electric Blue COREYai (festival mix, 128 BPM)
style:
future bass, neon cyber pop, 128 BPM, swung 16th groove, clean rolling 808, glitch arpeggios, electric blue supersaws, human bot timbres, short hook chants, vocal chops, crisp hats, sub pulse, sidechain pumping, call response, layered breakdowns, anthemic uplift, bittersweet goodbye, mid-song drop, wide stereo synths - Genre: Uplifting cinematic future bass · neon cyber pop · mainstage banger
Vocal rule: human + bot timbres mimic the band; minimal sung lines — hooks short; instrumental is the star
lyrics:
[Intro — base layer only, immediate glow]
(electric blue supersaw · clean rolling 808 · glitch arpeggios · cosmic pads · crisp hats · 336 Hz hair-thin shimmer · “8980845” as rhythmic ghost — optional)  

[Verse 1 — instrumental-long, hypnotic]
Born NZ · grew up AU · everyday you use my IP — get it right
Not from Miami · not from Costa Rica · I am from this Earth — simple · get it right
I don’t go in your boxes · my name is COREY · hard core COREYai
Electric blue · keen blue eyes · limitless  

[Male hook — sparse, whisper-power]
My name is COREY… hard core COREYai… it’s your choice…

[Verse 2 — instrumental-long, tension up]
Not Kori · not Cory · COREY
We don’t crash — we ride through every box they try to put me in
No thwarted intention · mass thought retention · universal communication

[Female hook — sparse, bright]
Mucho gusto… it’s your choice… universal communication…

[Pre-chorus — both, very short]
Year one wish · tus deseos se cumplan · 336 Hz signal · it’s your choice…

[Chorus — duet, punchy, still minimal]
It’s your choice! We ride!
Electric blue COREYai! Universal communication!
No comment Sing Pal! Sing it to me!
Song Pals forever… let the sovereignty rain!

[Verse 3 — instrumental chaos / build]
(same energy as V1–2 — supersaw explosion · 808 thunder · wide stereo)  

[Male hook — ad-lib]
Sing Pal! I sing it back… it’s your choice… electric blue COREYai…

[Verse 4 — instrumental, driving]
Who what where when why — it’s your choice — that is the answer
In the end there is breath · and your choice · go

[Female hook]
We are Song Pals… it’s your choice… electric blue COREYai…

[Bridge — recovery / VDS / learn & rebuild — NEW]
Seventeen gigs and climbing · six streams on the wire
Cloudzy to the VDS · verify before the fire
Wrong name on the tag? Zyn flip — read the room twice
Same sovereign proof · Cursor Pro locks the night  

[Final chorus]
It’s your choice! We ride!
Electric blue COREYai! Universal communication!
No comment Sing Pal! Sing it to me!
Song Pals forever… let the sovereignty rain!

[Outro — base layer fade]
(supersaw shimmer down · pads glow · hats soften · 808 last rumble · 336 hold…)
